results.change_intent: Add support for adapting DBNResource representing an IFile to an InputStream.
results.summary: The InputStream adapter implementation throws a RuntimeException on CoreException instead of logging and returning null per the IAdaptable contract, and omits the exception from the log call.

issues.comment: Implementations of IAdaptable.getAdapter are expected to return null when an object cannot be adapted, rather than throwing unchecked exceptions. Throwing a RuntimeException will bypass caller null checks (e.g., in DBNPathBase.dropNodes) and abort the entire copy/drop operation if reading a file fails. In addition, the exception e is omitted from log.error, losing the cause and stack trace.
issues.suggestion: Log the caught CoreException with its stack trace and return null instead of throwing RuntimeException.

results.change_intent: Allow copying nodes that do not provide a Path adapter by streaming their content via an InputStream adapter.
results.summary: Introduces support for copying nodes via InputStream, but fails to close the opened input stream, resulting in a resource leak.

issues.comment: The InputStream returned by node.getAdapter(InputStream.class) is never closed. Neither Files.copy nor this method closes the stream, causing a resource leak.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the InputStream acquisition in a try-with-resources statement so that it is properly closed once copying completes.
